text: Entry Requirements (1) Applicants of master degree programs should hold a bachelor degree certificate and transcript. (2) Applicants of English-taught bachelor and master degree programs should be good at English listening, speaking, reading and writing. (3) Be in good health and have no illegal or criminal record. (4) Applicants of master degree programs should prepare two recommendation letters written by the professors or associate professors, and should join the audition and examination held by CAUC.
